remarks: Water views across Veteran's Park in East Norwalk from this totally renovated, over-sized one bedroom second floor apartment. Large living room room w 9 foot ceilings and lots of natural light. Beautiful new kitchen w great counter space, lots of cabinets, plus new washer and dryer. Large bedroom with built-in closet system and a separate office. Totally remolded bathroom with shower. Second floor deck overlooking the park and Norwalk harbor is shared with other tenant. Central air, natural gas heat. Parking for 1 car in rear driveway, additional $50 per month. Tenant pays heat, electricity, credit check, liability insurance, cable, maintenance repairs. Great location within walking distance to East and South Norwalk train stations. 1 hour to NYC. Minutes walk to Sono restaurants and attractions. Credit check, no smoking, no pets. Available immediately.
